scope: Selected master-branch source paths read through web text; no commit-pinned whole-repository audit, clone, local source download, installation or execution.

observations.finding: The logger supports filter-origin lookup, creating filters and temporary exceptions. The editor responds to background filter changes. These are not missing capabilities.

The reviewed three-way editor merge assumes no background deletions. The reviewed write path submits content and saves it without an expected prior-content comparison in that call chain. A runtime race or lost update was not reproduced.
observations.blockAdsResponse: Keep unsaved drafts and reject a replacement when the stored text differs from the editor's base; test background additions and deletions.

observations.finding: The reviewed asset path tracks freshness at list level and the logger identifies originating lists. This inspection did not find a dated per-host threat-evidence panel in those paths, but does not establish its absence across the entire project.
observations.blockAdsResponse: Expose the existing reviewed threat catalog as inert, defanged addresses with report sources, original date precision, exact-host scope, expiry and verified layer status.

observations.finding: The current uBOL FAQ includes custom-filter and subscription support. Full uBO and uBOL have different browser architectures; BlockAds custom filtering is a parity step, not evidence of superiority.
